arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ

translations.en.sahih: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe,
translations.en.pickthall: Nun. By the pen and that which they write (therewith),
translations.en.yusufali: Nun. By the Pen and the (Record) which (men) write,-
translations.id.indonesian: Nun, demi kalam dan apa yang mereka tulis,

translations.en.sahih: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
translations.en.pickthall: Thou art not, for thy Lord's favour unto thee, a madman.
translations.en.yusufali: Thou art not, by the Grace of thy Lord, mad or possessed.
translations.id.indonesian: berkat nikmat Tuhanmu kamu (Muhammad) sekali-kali bukan orang gila.

transliteration: Wa inna laka la ajran ghaira mamnoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! thine verily will be a reward unfailing.
translations.en.yusufali: Nay, verily for thee is a Reward unfailing:
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya bagi kamu benar-benar pahala yang besar yang tidak putus-putusnya.

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! thou art of a tremendous nature.
translations.en.yusufali: And thou (standest) on an exalted standard of character.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar berbudi pekerti yang agung.

translations.en.sahih: So you will see and they will see
translations.en.pickthall: And thou wilt see and they will see
translations.en.yusufali: Soon wilt thou see, and they will see,
translations.id.indonesian: Maka kelak kamu akan melihat dan mereka (orang-orang kafir)pun akan melihat,

translations.en.sahih: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
translations.en.pickthall: Which of you is the demented.
translations.en.yusufali: Which of you is afflicted with madness.
translations.id.indonesian: siapa di antara kamu yang gila.

arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
transliteration: Innaa Rabbaka Huwa a'lamu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee wa Huwa a'lamu bilmuhtadeen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is Best Aware of him who strayeth from His way, and He is Best Aware of those who walk aright.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily it is thy Lord that knoweth best, which (among men) hath strayed from His Path: and He knoweth best those who receive (true) Guidance.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah Yang Paling Mengetahui siapa yang sesat dari jalan-Nya; dan Dialah Yang Paling Mengetahui orang-orang yang mendapat petunjuk.

translations.en.sahih: Then do not obey the deniers.
translations.en.pickthall: Therefor obey not thou the rejecters
translations.en.yusufali: So hearken not to those who deny (the Truth).
translations.id.indonesian: Maka janganlah kamu ikuti orang-orang yang mendustakan (ayat-ayat Allah).

translations.en.sahih: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
translations.en.pickthall: Who would have had thee compromise, that they may compromise.
translations.en.yusufali: Their desire is that thou shouldst be pliant: so would they be pliant.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka mereka menginginkan supaya kamu bersikap lunak lalu mereka bersikap lunak (pula kepadamu).

transliteration: Wa laa tuti' kulla hallaa fim maheen

translations.en.sahih: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
translations.en.pickthall: Neither obey thou each feeble oath-monger,
translations.en.yusufali: Heed not the type of despicable men,- ready with oaths,
translations.id.indonesian: Dan janganlah kamu ikuti setiap orang yang banyak bersumpah lagi hina,

translations.en.sahih: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
translations.en.pickthall: Detracter, spreader abroad of slanders,
translations.en.yusufali: A slanderer, going about with calumnies,
translations.id.indonesian: yang banyak mencela, yang kian ke mari menghambur fitnah,

translations.en.sahih: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
translations.en.pickthall: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, malefactor
translations.en.yusufali: (Habitually) hindering (all) good, transgressing beyond bounds, deep in sin,
translations.id.indonesian: yang banyak menghalangi perbuatan baik, yang melampaui batas lagi banyak dosa,

translations.en.sahih: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
translations.en.pickthall: Greedy therewithal, intrusive.
translations.en.yusufali: Violent (and cruel),- with all that, base-born,-
translations.id.indonesian: yang kaku kasar, selain dari itu, yang terkenal kejahatannya,

translations.en.sahih: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
translations.en.pickthall: It is because he is possessed of wealth and children
translations.en.yusufali: Because he possesses wealth and (numerous) sons.
translations.id.indonesian: karena dia mempunyai (banyak) harta dan anak.

arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
transliteration: Izaa tutlaa 'alaihi aayaatunaa qaala asaateerul awwaleen

translations.en.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
translations.en.pickthall: That, when Our revelations are recited unto him, he saith: Mere fables of the men of old.
translations.en.yusufali: When to him are rehearsed Our Signs, "Tales of the ancients", he cries!
translations.id.indonesian: Apabila dibacakan kepadanya ayat-ayat Kami, ia berkata: "(Ini adalah) dongeng-dongengan orang-orang dahulu kala".

translations.en.sahih: We will brand him upon the snout.
translations.en.pickthall: We shall brand him on the nose.
translations.en.yusufali: Soon shall We brand (the beast) on the snout!
translations.id.indonesian: Kelak akan Kami beri tanda dia di belalai(nya).

arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
transliteration: Innaa balawnaahum kamaa balawnaaa As-haabal jannati iz 'aqsamoo la-yasri munnahaa musbiheen

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! We have tried them as We tried the owners of the garden when they vowed that they would pluck its fruit next morning,
translations.en.yusufali: Verily We have tried them as We tried the People of the Garden, when they resolved to gather the fruits of the (garden) in the morning.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mencobai mereka (musyrikin Mekah) sebagaimana Kami telah mencobai pemilik-pemilik kebun, ketika mereka bersumpah bahwa mereka sungguh-sungguh akanmemetik (hasil)nya di pagi hari,

translations.en.sahih: Without making exception.
translations.en.pickthall: And made no exception (for the Will of Allah);
translations.en.yusufali: But made no reservation, ("If it be Allah's Will").
translations.id.indonesian: dan mereka tidak menyisihkan (hak fakir miskin),

arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
transliteration: Fataafa 'alaihaa taaa'i fum mir rabbika wa hum naaa'imoon

translations.en.sahih: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
translations.en.pickthall: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
translations.en.yusufali: Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.
translations.id.indonesian: lalu kebun itu diliputi malapetaka (yang datang) dari Tuhanmu ketika mereka sedang tidur,

translations.en.sahih: And it became as though reaped.
translations.en.pickthall: And in the morning it was as if plucked.
translations.en.yusufali: So the (garden) became, by the morning, like a dark and desolate spot, (whose fruit had been gathered).
translations.id.indonesian: maka jadilah kebun itu hitam seperti malam yang gelap gulita.

translations.en.sahih: And they called one another at morning,
translations.en.pickthall: And they cried out one unto another in the morning,
translations.en.yusufali: As the morning broke, they called out, one to another,-
translations.id.indonesian: lalu mereka panggil memanggil di pagi hari:

arabic: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
translations.en.pickthall: Saying: Run unto your field if ye would pluck (the fruit).
translations.en.yusufali: "Go ye to your tilth (betimes) in the morning, if ye would gather the fruits."
translations.id.indonesian: "Pergilah diwaktu pagi (ini) ke kebunmu jika kamu hendak memetik buahnya".

translations.en.sahih: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
translations.en.pickthall: So they went off, saying one unto another in low tones:
translations.en.yusufali: So they departed, conversing in secret low tones, (saying)-
translations.id.indonesian: Maka pergilah mereka saling berbisik-bisik.

arabic: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ

translations.en.sahih: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
translations.en.pickthall: No needy man shall enter it to-day against you.
translations.en.yusufali: "Let not a single indigent person break in upon you into the (garden) this day."
translations.id.indonesian: "Pada hari ini janganlah ada seorang miskinpun masuk ke dalam kebunmu".

translations.en.sahih: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
translations.en.pickthall: They went betimes, strong in (this) purpose.
translations.en.yusufali: And they opened the morning, strong in an (unjust) resolve.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan berangkatlah mereka di pagi hari dengan niat menghalangi (orang-orang miskin) padahal mereka (menolongnya).

transliteration: Falammaa ra awhaa qaalooo innaa ladaaalloon

translations.en.sahih: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
translations.en.pickthall: But when they saw it, they said: Lo! we are in error!
translations.en.yusufali: But when they saw the (garden), they said: "We have surely lost our way:
translations.id.indonesian: Tatkala mereka melihat kebun itu, mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kita benar-benar orang-orang yang sesat (jalan),

translations.en.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
translations.en.pickthall: Nay, but we are desolate!
translations.en.yusufali: "Indeed we are shut out (of the fruits of our labour)!"
translations.id.indonesian: bahkan kita dihalangi (dari memperoleh hasilnya)".

arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
transliteration: Qaala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum law laa tusabbihoon

translations.en.sahih: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "
translations.en.pickthall: The best among them said: Said I not unto you: Why glorify ye not (Allah)?
translations.en.yusufali: Said one of them, more just (than the rest): "Did I not say to you, 'Why not glorify (Allah)?'"
translations.id.indonesian: Berkatalah seorang yang paling baik pikirannya di antara mereka: "Bukankah aku telah mengatakan kepadamu, hendaklah kamu bertasbih (kepada Tuhanmu)?"

arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
transliteration: Qaaloo subhaana rabbinaaa innaa kunnaa zaalimeen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Glorified be our Lord! Lo! we have been wrong-doers.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Glory to our Lord! Verily we have been doing wrong!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka mengucapkan: "Maha Suci Tuhan kami, sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang zalim".

translations.en.sahih: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
translations.en.pickthall: Then some of them drew near unto others, self-reproaching.
translations.en.yusufali: Then they turned, one against another, in reproach.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu sebahagian mereka menghadapi sebahagian yang lain seraya cela mencela.

transliteration: Qaaloo yaa wailanaaa innaa kunnaa taagheen

translations.en.sahih: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
translations.en.pickthall: They said: Alas for us! In truth we were outrageous.
translations.en.yusufali: They said: "Alas for us! We have indeed transgressed!
translations.id.indonesian: Mereka berkata: "Aduhai celakalah kita; sesungguhnya kita ini adalah orang-orang yang melampaui batas".

arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
transliteration: 'Asaa rabbunaaa any yubdilanaa khairam minhaaa innaaa ilaa rabbinaa raaghiboon

translations.en.sahih: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
translations.en.pickthall: It may be that our Lord will give us better than this in place thereof. Lo! we beseech our Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: "It may be that our Lord will give us in exchange a better (garden) than this: for we do turn to Him (in repentance)!"
translations.id.indonesian: Mudah-mudahan Tuhan kita memberikan ganti kepada kita dengan (kebun) yang lebih baik daripada itu; sesungguhnya kita mengharapkan ampunan dari Tuhan kita.

arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Kazaalikal azaab, wa la'azaabul aakhirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
translations.en.pickthall: Such was the punishment. And verily the punishment of the Hereafter is greater if they did but know.
translations.en.yusufali: Such is the Punishment (in this life); but greater is the Punishment in the Hereafter,- if only they knew!
translations.id.indonesian: Seperti itulah azab (dunia). Dan sesungguhnya azab akhirat lebih besar jika mereka mengetahui.

arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ

translations.en.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
translations.en.pickthall: Lo! for those who keep from evil are gardens of bliss with their Lord.
translations.en.yusufali: Verily, for the Righteous, are Gardens of Delight, in the Presence of their Lord.
translations.id.indonesian: Sesungguhnya bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa (disediakan) surga-surga yang penuh kenikmatan di sisi Tuhannya.

translations.en.sahih: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
translations.en.pickthall: Shall We then treat those who have surrendered as We treat the guilty?
translations.en.yusufali: Shall We then treat the People of Faith like the People of Sin?
translations.id.indonesian: Maka apakah patut Kami menjadikan orang-orang Islam itu sama dengan orang-orang yang berdosa (orang kafir)?

translations.en.sahih: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
translations.en.pickthall: What aileth you? How foolishly ye judge!
translations.en.yusufali: What is the matter with you? How judge ye?
translations.id.indonesian: Atau adakah kamu (berbuat demikian): bagaimanakah kamu mengambil keputusan?

translations.en.sahih: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
translations.en.pickthall: Or have ye a scripture wherein ye learn
translations.en.yusufali: Or have ye a book through which ye learn-
translations.id.indonesian: Atau adakah kamu mempunyai sebuah kitab (yang diturunkan Allah) yang kamu membacanya?,

translations.en.sahih: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
translations.en.pickthall: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?
translations.en.yusufali: That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?
translations.id.indonesian: bahwa di dalamnya kamu benar-benar boleh memilih apa yang kamu sukai untukmu.

arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
transliteration: Am lakum aymaanun 'alainaa baalighatun ilaa yawmil qiyaamati inna lakum lamaa tahkumoon

translations.en.sahih: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
translations.en.pickthall: Or have ye a covenant on oath from Us that reacheth to the Day of Judgment, that yours shall be all that ye ordain?
translations.en.yusufali: Or have ye Covenants with Us to oath, reaching to the Day of Judgment, (providing) that ye shall have whatever ye shall demand?
translations.id.indonesian: Atau apakah kamu memperoleh janji yang diperkuat dengan sumpah dari Kami, yang tetap berlaku sampai hari kiamat; sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar dapat mengambil keputusan (sekehendakmu)?

translations.en.sahih: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
translations.en.pickthall: Ask them (O Muhammad) which of them will vouch for that!
translations.en.yusufali: Ask thou of them, which of them will stand surety for that!
translations.id.indonesian: Tanyakanlah kepada mereka: "Siapakah di antara mereka yang bertanggung jawab terhadap keputusan yang diambil itu?"

arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
transliteration: Am lahum shurakaaa'u falyaatoo bishurakaaa 'ihim in kaanoo saadiqeen

translations.en.sahih: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
translations.en.pickthall: Or have they other gods? Then let them bring their other gods if they are truthful
translations.en.yusufali: Or have they some "Partners" (in Allahhead)? Then let them produce their "partners", if they are truthful!
translations.id.indonesian: Atau apakah mereka mempunyai sekutu-sekutu? Maka hendaklah mereka mendatangkan sekutu-sekutunya jika mereka adalah orang-orang yang benar.

arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
transliteration: Yawma yukshafu 'am saaqinw wa yud'awna ilas sujoodi falaa yastatee'oon

translations.en.sahih: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
translations.en.pickthall: On the day when it befalleth in earnest, and they are ordered to prostrate themselves but are not able,
translations.en.yusufali: The Day that the shin shall be laid bare, and they shall be summoned to bow in adoration, but they shall not be able,-
translations.id.indonesian: Pada hari betis disingkapkan dan mereka dipanggil untuk bersujud; maka mereka tidak kuasa,

arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
transliteration: Khaashi'atan absaaruhum tarhaquhum zillatunw wa qad kaanoo yud'awna ilassujoodi wa hum saalimoon

translations.en.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
translations.en.pickthall: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.
translations.en.yusufali: Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).
translations.id.indonesian: (dalam keadaan) pandangan mereka tunduk ke bawah, lagi mereka diliputi kehinaan. Dan sesungguhnya mereka dahulu (di dunia) diseru untuk bersujud, dan mereka dalam keadaan sejahtera.

arabic: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
transliteration: Fazarnee wa many yukazzibu bihaazal hadeesi sanastad rijuhum min haisu laa ya'lamoon

translations.en.sahih: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
translations.en.pickthall: Leave Me (to deal) with those who give the lie to this pronouncement. We shall lead them on by steps from whence they know not.
translations.en.yusufali: Then leave Me alone with such as reject this Message: by degrees shall We punish them from directions they perceive not.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka serahkanlah (ya Muhammad) kepada-Ku (urusan) orang-orang yang mendustakan perkataan ini (Al Quran). Nanti Kami akan menarik mereka dengan berangsur-angsur (ke arah kebinasaan) dari arah yang tidak mereka ketahui,

transliteration: Wa umlee lahum; inna kaidee mateen

translations.en.sahih: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
translations.en.pickthall: Yet I bear with them, for lo! My scheme is firm.
translations.en.yusufali: A (long) respite will I grant them: truly powerful is My Plan.
translations.id.indonesian: dan Aku memberi tangguh kepada mereka. Sesungguhnya rencana-Ku amat tangguh.

arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
transliteration: Am tas'aluhum ajran fahum mim maghramim musqaloon

translations.en.sahih: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
translations.en.pickthall: Or dost thou (Muhammad) ask a fee from them so that they are heavily taxed?
translations.en.yusufali: Or is it that thou dost ask them for a reward, so that they are burdened with a load of debt?-
translations.id.indonesian: Apakah kamu meminta upah kepada mereka, lalu mereka diberati dengan hutang?

translations.en.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
translations.en.pickthall: Or is the Unseen theirs that they can write (thereof)?
translations.en.yusufali: Or that the Unseen is in their hands, so that they can write it down?
translations.id.indonesian: Ataukah ada pada mereka ilmu tentang yang ghaib lalu mereka menulis (padanya apa yang mereka tetapkan)?

arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
transliteration: Fasbir lihkmi rabbika wa laa takun kasaahibil boot; iz naadaa wa huwa makzoom

translations.en.sahih: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
translations.en.pickthall: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.
translations.en.yusufali: So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.
translations.id.indonesian: Maka bersabarlah kamu (hai Muhammad) terhadap ketetapan Tuhanmu, dan janganlah kamu seperti orang yang berada dalam (perut) ikan ketika ia berdoa sedang ia dalam keadaan marah (kepada kaumnya).

arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
transliteration: Law laaa an tadaara kahoo ni'matum mir rabbihee lanubiza bil'araaa'i wa huwa mazmoom

translations.en.sahih: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
translations.en.pickthall: Had it not been that favour from his Lord had reached him he surely had been cast into the wilderness while he was reprobate.
translations.en.yusufali: Had not Grace from his Lord reached him, he would indeed have been cast off on the naked shore, in disgrace.
translations.id.indonesian: Kalau sekiranya ia tidak segera mendapat nikmat dari Tuhannya, benar-benar ia dicampakkan ke tanah tandus dalam keadaan tercela.

translations.en.sahih: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
translations.en.pickthall: But his Lord chose him and placed him among the righteous.
translations.en.yusufali: Thus did his Lord choose him and make him of the Company of the Righteous.
translations.id.indonesian: Lalu Tuhannya memilihnya dan menjadikannya termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
transliteration: Wa iny-yakaadul lazeena kafaroo la-yuzliqoonaka biabsaarihim lammaa saml'uz-Zikra wa yaqooloona innahoo lamajnoon

translations.en.sahih: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
translations.en.pickthall: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
translations.en.yusufali: And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"
translations.id.indonesian: Dan sesungguhnya orang-orang kafir itu benar-benar hampir menggelincirkan kamu dengan pandangan mereka, tatkala mereka mendengar Al Quran dan mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya ia (Muhammad) benar-benar orang yang gila".

transliteration: Wa maa huwa illaa zikrul lil'aalameen

translations.en.sahih: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
translations.en.pickthall: When it is naught else than a Reminder to creation.
translations.en.yusufali: But it is nothing less than a Message to all the worlds.
translations.id.indonesian: Dan Al Quran itu tidak lain hanyalah peringatan bagi seluruh umat.
